 Mr. Sameer K. Sawant with Ms. Pallavi Mane, for the Applicant.
 Coram : Sandeep V. Marne, J.

P.C :
1) Heard Mr. Sawant, the learned counsel appearing for the Applicant.
2) The Applicant has filed application for restoration of the Revision Application.

After considering the averments and after having considered the submissions canvassed by the learned counsel appearing for the Applicant, I am of the view that an opportunity deserves to be granted to the Applicant to prosecute the Revision Application.
Accordingly the order dated 17 June 2017 by which the suit has been dismissed is recalled.
The Civil Revision Application is restored to file.

3) List the Revision Application for further consideration on 29 January 2026.
